description: Phase 4: GRPO with verifiable rewards from the SFT model (checkpoints/sft_L). 200 steps of 16 training prompts x 8 rollouts at temperature 1, LR 3e-5 after 10 warmup steps. KL coefficient ablation: 0.1 (main run, snapshots every 50 steps evaluated for a learning curve), 0 (no penalty), and 1 (strong penalty). The main setting is repeated with seeds 29 and 43 (prompt order and rollout sampling) to measure run-to-run variation. Every policy is evaluated like phase 3: the 500 eval prompts x 4 samples at T 0.8 / top-p 0.95, constraint checks, and fluency under the pretrained L.
